svg.title: claudia — object interaction: where the code goes, and why
svg.desc: Layers from the core model and the server methods, through the shared client modules and the ObjectHost interface, to the three per-app adapters and components, with the tests that pin the contract.
svg.text: claudia — object interaction: where the code goes, and why
Architecture for review. Solid: exists today. Dashed: proposed in notes/object-interaction-contract.md. The rule from D177 (shared body, app-specific anchor) is carried to the client.
MODEL AND SERVER — already shared (D177), nothing to change
claudia_core: ObjectBody + Anchor
ObjectBody(id, kind, w, h, rotation, snap, …): one dataclass for all
Anchor → SlideAnchor · CellAnchor · BlockAnchor(block, offset, dx, dy)
kinds: text · shape · image · rendered · diagram · table
one command family: core.MoveObject / ResizeObject / RotateObject
server methods move_object · resize_object · rotate_object in every app
_check_visual refuses a resize that breaks an image’s aspect → the client must keep it
each gesture is one history entry, for everybody (D82)
kernel tables (D1201) and renderings (D390)
a table object points at a TableDef; its h is only what layout found
a rendered container keeps no aspect; its size is set at insertion (too large today)
SHARED CLIENT CODE — web/app/lib and components, written once
object-gestures.ts
press → threshold(3 px) → move | handle | turn → release | Esc
pure: positions in, preview frame + one Commit out
reuses moveFrame, resizeFrame, moveTurned, …
Bounds passed in, not SLIDE_W/SLIDE_H
aspect + grid are inputs
geometry.ts · turning.ts
today: written for the slide (SLIDE_W, SLIDE_H, slide units)
change: take a Bounds { w, h } and the unit from the host
each app passes its own bounds
behaviour of creates is unchanged
useObjectInteraction(host)
wires gestures to pointer events with capture
press: stopPropagation; contextmenu: preventDefault + select
keys: Esc · Del · Enter/F2 · arrows · Tab · Select Next Object
focus rules; the Ctrl+click exception (wrap behind text)
one place that says nothing passes through
ObjectFrame.vue
outline + 8 (or 4) handles + turn handle + names for assistive tech
moved out of SlideCanvas.vue; used by all three apps
a table gets the same component with the right-edge handle only
exactly one frame per selected object (the e2e counts it)
object-menu.ts (exists)
one item list, one order, one key per item
snap is optional: creates passes it, the others leave it off
table entries added for kind table (from table-menu.ts)
ContextMenu.vue (exists)
the generic menu creates already uses
composes and computes use it the same way
replaces the paragraph and cell menus on objects
interface ObjectHost (the only seam)
toUnits(event) · frameOf(o) · bounds() · grid()
aspectOf(o) · commitMove · commitResize · commitTurn
objects() · select(id) · menuActions(o)
table specifics (composes only)
drop line between paragraphs · width handle in 1/100 %
no turn handle · no height handle
name tab + Options… live outside the object layer
PER APP — a host adapter + its component
creates: slide-object-host.ts + SlideCanvas.vue
frameOf → slide frame · commitMove → move_object(x, y) · grid 50 if snap
SlideCanvas keeps editing text, the style menu, presence and tints
behaviour unchanged: its e2e (slides.cjs) stays green after the move
computes: sheet-object-host.ts + SheetGrid.vue
frameOf → cell top-left + w×h · commitMove → move_object(row, col)
the viewport’s contextmenu.capture yields to an object under the pointer
mouse events → pointer events; handles, turn and the menu are new
composes: text-object-host.ts + TextContainers.vue
frameOf → character spot + offset (floatBox) · commitMove → move_object(block, offset, dx, dy)
the layer skips kind=table (TableView is the one body); aspect lock; turn handle
TextEditor.onContextMenu yields on [data-object]; behind-text layer: Ctrl+click
why one adapter each and not three copies
the three differ in three things only: units, where the frame is, what move commits
everything else is the contract, and a contract is written once
what we do not share
selection holding (open point 1), wrap (composes), cells (computes)
they stay in the app; the host exposes only what gestures need
dependency rule
components → useObjectInteraction → object-gestures → geometry
nothing in lib/ imports a component or an app’s session
TESTS — the contract is checked with every new feature
vitest: object-gestures.test.ts, object-menu.test.ts
thresholds, preview, commit, Esc, aspect, bounds, turned frames
the menu list per kind and per app (no Snap outside creates)
a host with a missing member fails to type-check
e2e: web/e2e/objects.cjs (npm run e2e:objects)
one spec, three apps, one object of every kind
press · drag · Esc · scale (image keeps ratio) · turn · right press · keys
nothing below received the press · one frame · no paragraph/cell menu
guard: tests/test_object_kinds_agree.py (exists, extended)
every kind of the three apps has a row in objects.cjs’s kind table
a new kind cannot ship without its interaction row
CI runs e2e:objects beside the other specs
